evidence.tag:system-apocalypse: Aliens destroy Earth's surface and force the survivors into a televised dungeon.

evidence.tag:male-mc: Carl, a former Coast Guard mechanic, is the protagonist.
evidence.tag:animal-companion: Princess Donut, his ex-girlfriend's show cat, gains intelligence and fights beside him.

evidence.tag:levels: Crawlers gain levels and stat points.
evidence.tag:stats: Strength, Constitution and other attributes appear on status screens.

evidence.tag:isekai: Jason Asano, an Australian office worker, wakes up in a world of magic and monsters.
evidence.tag:ranks-tiers: Essence users advance through iron, bronze, silver, gold and diamond ranks.
evidence.tag:skills: Essence abilities with full descriptions are shown in status screens.
evidence.tag:loot: Essences, awakening stones and gear are prized drops.

evidence.tag:isekai: Erin Solstice walks from Earth into a world of monsters and classes.

evidence.tag:vrmmo: Marcus and his friends dive into Ascend Online, a new full-immersion VR game.
evidence.tag:party-focused: The story follows a group of friends who play together.
evidence.tag:levels: Levels are tracked.
evidence.tag:stats: Attribute points are allocated.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills are learned and leveled.

evidence.tag:vrmmo: New Era Online is a futuristic virtual-reality game.

evidence.tag:system-apocalypse: The System arrives on Earth and monsters appear.

evidence.tag:academy: Corin enters the Lorian Heights academy after his attunement.

evidence.tag:young-mc: Taylor is a fifteen-year-old high-school student.
evidence.tag:modern-earth: Set in Brockton Bay on an alternate modern Earth.
evidence.tag:villain-mc: Taylor ends up running with a team of teenage villains.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: She wins through creative use of a seemingly weak bug-control power.
evidence.tag:multiple-pov: Interludes are told from many other characters' viewpoints.
evidence.tag:serious-epic: Escalating, earnest stakes up to world-ending threats.
evidence.tag:grimdark: Bleak consequences and morally gray choices throughout.
evidence.in_scope: adjudicated: Superhero progression is an in-scope genre, and Worm is the cape-fiction benchmark.
evidence.tag:weak-to-strong: adjudicated: A bullied girl with a 'weak' bug power rises to be one of the most feared capes.
evidence.tag:politics: adjudicated: Gangs, heroes and factions scheme over Brockton Bay.

evidence.tag:op-mc: A grown dragon far stronger than most of the world.
evidence.tag:villain-mc: He hoards gold, kidnaps princesses and makes adventurers miserable.
evidence.tag:classes: He learns about classes and decides to take one.
evidence.tag:levels: Levels are part of the RPG rules he discovers.
evidence.tag:questing: Quests are his new route to more gold.
evidence.tag:humorous: Comedy driven by the dragon's vanity and cluelessness.
evidence.tag:satire: Skewers RPG conventions from a monster's point of view.
evidence.tag:multiple-pov: adjudicated: Vainqueur's chapters alternate with Victor's and others'.

evidence.tag:academy: Set in a university Hero Certification Program.
evidence.tag:modern-earth: Set in the present-day United States.
evidence.tag:party-focused: A core group of students trains and struggles together.
evidence.tag:found-family: The group of former Powereds becomes a family.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: Hero classes, sparring and training fill the school year.
evidence.tag:humorous: Frequent banter and comic characters.
evidence.tag:young-mc: adjudicated: The cast are college students aged 18 or older, not a teen-MC story.
evidence.tag:lighthearted: adjudicated: An upbeat campus story with plenty of humor.
evidence.tag:heroic: adjudicated: Good-hearted students training to become heroes.

evidence.tag:young-mc: Volke is a sixteen-year-old gravedigger.
evidence.tag:monster-taming: Arcanists gain magic by bonding mystical creatures; Volke bonds a knightmare.
evidence.tag:weak-to-strong: A lowly gravedigger shadowed by his parents' infamy.
evidence.tag:animal-companion: adjudicated: Luthair is a sentient knight-like mentor, not an animal or pet.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: adjudicated: He trains as an apprentice arcanist under Zelfree.
evidence.tag:lighthearted: adjudicated: Reviews note an upbeat YA tone with humor and sarcasm.

evidence.tag:gates-and-hunters: Gates spill monsters into the world and ranked hunters clear them.
evidence.tag:hidden-system: After the double dungeon, only Jinwoo can see the System.
evidence.tag:solo-mc: He levels alone through the System's quests and instant dungeons.
evidence.tag:weak-to-strong: He starts as the weakest E-rank hunter.
evidence.tag:ranks-tiers: Hunters are ranked from E to S.
evidence.tag:dungeon-crawler: Clearing gates and dungeons is the core loop.
evidence.tag:levels: His level rises visibly with each fight.
evidence.tag:stats: Status windows show strength, agility and other stats he assigns.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills are granted and upgraded by the System.
evidence.tag:loot: Item drops and gear upgrades matter.
evidence.tag:system-mystery: adjudicated: Who made the System and why it chose him is dug into across the series.
evidence.tag:necromancy: adjudicated: Raising fallen enemies as shadow soldiers becomes his core power.
evidence.tag:cheat-ability: adjudicated: He alone can level up, a unique advantage.
evidence.tag:op-mc: adjudicated: He quickly outgrows every other hunter; the series is a dominant power fantasy.
evidence.tag:serious-epic: adjudicated: Played straight, with escalating world-level stakes.

evidence.tag:vrmmo: Viridian Gate Online is a VRMMORPG.
evidence.tag:trapped-in-game: With an asteroid about to hit Earth, Jack uploads into the game for good.
evidence.tag:party-focused: He adventures with companions, including the thief Cutter.
evidence.tag:levels: Standard RPG levels are tracked.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills and abilities are gained and leveled.
evidence.tag:stats: Status screens show his attributes.
evidence.tag:heroic: adjudicated: Gritty dark-templar adventure; not a noblebright tone.
evidence.tag:class-unique: adjudicated: His rare Dark Templar class is a plot point.
evidence.tag:loot: adjudicated: Gear and item drops matter in a crunchy VRMMO.

evidence.tag:vrmmo: Joe plays in Eternium, a full-immersion game world.
evidence.tag:class-unique: He earns the rare Ritualist class by completing every trial.
evidence.tag:build-crafting: He plans stat spending and skill choices carefully.
evidence.tag:levels: Levels are tracked.
evidence.tag:stats: Full stat sheets appear regularly.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills are learned and leveled by use.
evidence.tag:humorous: Jaxon, a chiropractor who loves rearranging spines, is typical of the comedy.
evidence.tag:class-mage: adjudicated: Ritualist is a spellcasting class.
evidence.tag:party-focused: adjudicated: Joe runs dungeons with a regular party in book 1.
evidence.tag:titles-achievements: adjudicated: His completionist habit earns titles and achievements with effects.
evidence.tag:lighthearted: adjudicated: An upbeat, easygoing game adventure.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: adjudicated: He wins more through persistence than through intellect.
evidence.tag:questing: adjudicated: Completing every quest the game offers structures the book.

evidence.tag:nonhuman-mc: The protagonist is a newborn demon.
evidence.tag:monster-mc: She evolves from an infant demon into an Imp and beyond.
evidence.tag:race-evolution: Evolving into new demon forms is the core progression.
evidence.tag:levels: She gains experience and levels.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills are gained as she levels and evolves.
evidence.harem: adjudicated: No romance setup; her bond with Haec is loyalty and companionship.
evidence.romance_level: adjudicated: Only faint hints at most; no romance thread.
evidence.tag:companions-progression: adjudicated: Haec evolves alongside her (into a Fiend as she becomes an Imp).
evidence.tag:survival: adjudicated: Surviving the hostile Netherworld is the core of the opening arc.
evidence.tag:lighthearted: adjudicated: A cheerful lead makes friends and punches jerks.
evidence.dial:pacing: adjudicated: Action-heavy fights but a slow-moving plot, so a balanced mix.

evidence.tag:weak-to-strong: His Tier 1 Talent is rated detrimental and no guild will take him.
evidence.tag:skills: Talents and skills are the core mechanics.
evidence.harem: adjudicated: The romance is a monogamous Matt and Liz pairing (tagged M/F).
evidence.tag:animal-companion: adjudicated: His bond Aster is an ice fox.
evidence.tag:companions-progression: adjudicated: Aster grows in power alongside him.
evidence.tag:tournament: adjudicated: The Path is a career-long race, not structured tournament arcs in book 1.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: adjudicated: Matt succeeds mainly through hard training rather than intellect.
evidence.tag:cultivation: adjudicated: The author bills it as LitRPG outside, xianxia inside.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: adjudicated: Much of the book is deliberate training and self-improvement.
evidence.tag:dungeon-crawler: adjudicated: Delving rifts (dungeons) is the core loop.
evidence.tag:slow-burn: adjudicated: Matt and Liz get together fairly early; the romance is not drawn out.

evidence.tag:vrmmo: Lee Hyun plays a full-dive virtual reality game as Weed.
evidence.tag:gamer-mc: A veteran gamer who once sold his old character for a fortune.
evidence.tag:class-unique: He takes the hidden Legendary Moonlight Sculptor class.
evidence.tag:crafting: Sculpting and other crafts are major activities.
evidence.tag:cooking: He cooks for his parties to feed and buff them.
evidence.tag:business: Money-obsessed; he grinds and sells to support his family.
evidence.tag:levels: Levels are tracked.
evidence.tag:stats: Stat windows show his attributes.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills are leveled by use.
evidence.tag:humorous: His stinginess and scheming are played for comedy.
evidence.tag:class-crafter: adjudicated: His Sculptor class is built around making things.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: adjudicated: He famously grinds at the training hall for weeks before leaving.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: adjudicated: Weed wins by scheming, planning and exploiting game knowledge.
evidence.tag:party-focused: adjudicated: Weed often plays solo and uses parties; the story centers on him.
evidence.tag:modern-earth: adjudicated: Most of the story is set in the game, with real-life chapters on the side.
evidence.tag:questing: adjudicated: Class and hidden quests structure the story.

book.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest

evidence.tag:isekai: Hajime and his whole class are summoned to another world.
evidence.tag:weak-to-strong: His Synergist class makes him the weakest of the summoned students.
evidence.tag:op-mc: He becomes vastly stronger than his classmates.
evidence.tag:skill-absorption: Eating monster flesh grants him their abilities.
evidence.tag:class-crafter: His Synergist class is a transmutation crafting class.
evidence.tag:crafting: He transmutes his own guns and gear.
evidence.tag:dungeon-crawler: He fights his way up from the depths of a great labyrinth.
evidence.tag:villain-mc: He turns into a ruthless antihero after being betrayed.
evidence.tag:stats: Status plates list numeric stats.
evidence.tag:skills: Skills are listed on status plates and grow.

evidence.tag:survival: adjudicated: Alone in the labyrinth, he must find food and survive.

book.title: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!

evidence.tag:isekai: Kazuma dies and is sent to a fantasy world.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: He wins through cunning tricks rather than stats.
evidence.tag:party-focused: His party of Aqua, Megumin and Darkness is the heart of the book.
evidence.tag:levels: Adventurer cards track levels.
evidence.tag:skills: Skill points buy skills like Steal.
evidence.tag:humorous: Comedy is the point.
evidence.tag:satire: Parodies isekai and fantasy RPG tropes.
evidence.tag:cheat-ability: adjudicated: The joke is that his chosen cheat, Aqua, is nearly useless, and he has no real advantage.

book.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

evidence.tag:academy: Most of the book takes place at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
evidence.tag:modern-earth: A hidden wizarding world inside contemporary Britain.
evidence.tag:found-family: Harry finds a family in his friends and at Hogwarts after a neglectful home.
evidence.tag:heroic: Brave children stand up to evil.
evidence.tag:lighthearted: Whimsical and warm for most of the book.
evidence.tag:young-mc: adjudicated: Harry is eleven; the young-MC filter should catch child protagonists.

evidence.tag:academy: Kvothe studies at the University, learning sympathy and other arcane arts.
evidence.tag:young-mc: Kvothe is a child and then a teenager for most of the story he tells.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: A prodigy who thinks and talks his way out of trouble.
evidence.tag:revenge: He seeks the Chandrian, who killed his family's troupe.
evidence.tag:weak-to-strong: adjudicated: Kvothe is a prodigy from childhood; his hardship is poverty, not weakness.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: adjudicated: Much page time goes to studying sympathy and other arts.
evidence.tag:slow-burn: adjudicated: His on-and-off romance with Denna builds slowly and never resolves.

evidence.tag:gamer-mc: Wade's encyclopedic knowledge of games and 1980s pop culture is his main tool.
evidence.tag:young-mc: Wade is a high-school student.
evidence.tag:cyberpunk: A dystopian future where a megacorporation hunts for control of the OASIS.
evidence.tag:questing: A hunt for keys and gates hidden by the OASIS creator drives the plot.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: He solves the creator's puzzles through obsessive research.

evidence.tag:slow-burn: Elizabeth and Darcy's relationship builds slowly from mutual dislike.
evidence.tag:satire: Gently mocks class, manners and the marriage market.
evidence.tag:humorous: Witty dialogue and comic side characters.

evidence.tag:space: Set on Mars during a crewed NASA mission.
evidence.tag:survival: Staying alive alone on Mars is the whole plot.
evidence.tag:solo-mc: He is completely alone on the planet.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: He solves each crisis with engineering and botany.
evidence.tag:humorous: His log entries are full of jokes and gallows humor.
evidence.tag:farming: adjudicated: Growing potatoes in the Hab is a major survival activity.
evidence.tag:multiple-pov: adjudicated: Chapters follow NASA staff and the Hermes crew as well as Watney.

evidence.tag:heist: Kelsier's crew plans to overthrow the Lord Ruler as an elaborate con.
evidence.tag:young-mc: Vin is sixteen.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: Vin learns Allomancy, burning metals for power, from Kelsier.

evidence.tag:multiple-pov: Vin and Kelsier share the viewpoint.
evidence.tag:politics: Noble balls and house intrigue are a major thread.
evidence.tag:revenge: Kelsier's hatred of the Lord Ruler drives the plan.

evidence.tag:military: Military training and command are central.
evidence.tag:space: Set largely in orbit, with an interstellar war looming.
evidence.tag:clever-mc: Ender wins through tactical genius.
evidence.tag:tournament: Zero-gravity battles between student armies are the core arcs.
evidence.tag:training-arcs: Relentless training shapes most of the book.
evidence.tag:war: Humanity prepares for war with an alien race.
evidence.tag:philosophical: Explores manipulation, empathy and the ethics of war.
